title: Efficient Lattice-Based Key Encapsulation for Constrained Devices
text: We present a lattice-based key encapsulation mechanism designed for post-quantum security on embedded hardware, with smaller keys and faster decapsulation.

title: Migrating TLS to Quantum-Resistant Signatures
text: This note discusses the practical migration of TLS deployments to post-quantum digital signatures and the performance cost of larger signatures.

title: Faster Homomorphic Encryption for Private Neural Network Inference
text: We accelerate fully homomorphic encryption so that a client can run neural network inference on encrypted data without revealing the input to the server.

title: Secure Multi-Party Computation for Private Set Intersection
text: A new protocol for private set intersection based on secure multi-party computation reduces communication between parties holding sensitive sets.

title: A Tight Security Proof for Authenticated Key Exchange
text: We give a tight reduction for an authenticated key exchange protocol in the standard model, improving previous security bounds.

title: Cryptanalysis of a Lightweight Block Cipher
text: We analyze a lightweight block cipher and show differential attacks that reduce the effective number of secure rounds.

title: Deep Learning for Network Intrusion Detection in IoT Traffic
text: We train a deep neural network for intrusion detection on IoT network traffic and compare it with classical anomaly detection baselines.

title: Detecting Ransomware Through Operating System Call Patterns
text: A malware detection approach that models operating system call sequences to identify ransomware behavior early, before files are encrypted.
